# Production calendar and allocation

Synthetic role-play evidence.

From: Riley Park, NorthStar Robotics
To: Alex Morgan, NorthStar Robotics
Date: 2026-10-26
Case: NS-2026-1042

The October 26 opening snapshot has 120 usable warehouse HDR-200 drives. The 80 pilot-line drives are a separate pool and remain reserved until the pilot owner approves release. There are no finished robots or WIP in this fixture. One Fremont line starts at most 60 robots per business day across both plans. Material usable on day zero can start that day; shipment follows two business days later. Protect contracted orders first, sorted by promise date and then sales order ID. SwiftLog material need-by is November 3; BayShip and NovaFab material need-by is November 4. Forecast FC-001 may be deferred.

# Supplier Email — Updated Delivery Schedule

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document ID | DOC-SUP-001 |

**From:** Daniel Reyes, Account Manager, Pacific Motion Systems  
**To:** Supply Chain Team, NorthStar Robotics  
**Date:** Friday, October 16, 2026  
**Subject:** Updated Delivery Schedule — PO-2026-1042 (HDR-200 Harmonic Drive Reducers, 400 Units)

Dear NorthStar Robotics Team,

I am writing with an important update regarding purchase order **PO-2026-1042** for **400 units of the HDR-200 harmonic drive reducer**, originally scheduled for delivery to your Fremont facility on **October 20, 2026**.

Due to production capacity constraints at our gear-finishing plant, including an unplanned maintenance shutdown on one of our two honing lines, we are unable to meet the original delivery schedule.

The revised delivery date for all **400 HDR-200 units is November 10, 2026**, representing a **21-day delay** from the original commitment.

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer a partial shipment or expedited delivery before November 10.

We understand that this delay may affect your production schedule and sincerely apologize for the disruption. We will continue monitoring our production progress and notify you immediately if the delivery schedule changes.

Please let us know if you require any additional information.

Best regards,  
**Daniel Reyes**  
Account Manager  
Pacific Motion Systems
